---- MODULE W4Od4m6p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Stations, MaxEpoch, LeaseDur
NoOwner == "none"
Msgs == [from: Stations, ep: 1..MaxEpoch]
VARIABLES owner, epoch, fuel, net, grants, movers
vars == <<owner, epoch, fuel, net, grants, movers>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ owner \in Stations \cup {NoOwner}
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ fuel \in 0..LeaseDur
  /\ net \subseteq Msgs
  /\ grants \subseteq Msgs
  /\ movers \subseteq Msgs

Init ==
  /\ owner = NoOwner
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ fuel = 0
  /\ net = {}
  /\ grants = {}
  /\ movers = {}

Grant(s) ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ owner' = s
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ fuel' = LeaseDur
  /\ grants' = grants \cup {[from |-> s, ep |-> epoch + 1]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<net, movers>>

Send ==
  /\ owner # NoOwner
  /\ fuel > 0
  /\ epoch >= 1
  /\ net' = net \cup {[from |-> owner, ep |-> epoch]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, epoch, fuel, grants, movers>>

Age ==
  /\ fuel > 0
  /\ fuel' = fuel - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, epoch, net, grants, movers>>

Revoke ==
  /\ owner # NoOwner
  /\ fuel = 0
  /\ owner' = NoOwner
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, fuel, net, grants, movers>>

ApplyValid(m) ==
  /\ m.from = owner
  /\ m.ep = epoch
  /\ fuel > 0
  /\ movers' = movers \cup {m}
  /\ net' = net \ {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, epoch, fuel, grants>>

ApplyStale(m) ==
  /\ (m.from # owner \/ m.ep # epoch \/ fuel = 0)
  /\ net' = net \ {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, epoch, fuel, grants, movers>>

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Stations : Grant(s)
  \/ Send
  \/ Age
  \/ Revoke
  \/ \E m \in net : ApplyValid(m)
  \/ \E m \in net : ApplyStale(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AllAppliedWereGranted == movers \subseteq grants
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Stations = {s1, s2}
  MaxEpoch = 2
  LeaseDur = 1
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AllAppliedWereGranted
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line hands control of the moving belt to one wash station at a time using a short-lived lease. A supervisor grants the lease to a station together with a fuel budget that counts down as time passes; when the fuel reaches zero the lease is expired. Every grant is stamped with a fresh, strictly increasing epoch number, and each granted (station, epoch) pair is written into an authorization ledger. While it holds a live lease a station emits "advance the belt" commands onto the shared network; these commands carry the station's identity and the epoch under which they were issued. Because the network can reorder and delay messages, a command issued under an old lease may arrive after the lease has been re-granted to another station or has expired. When a command is delivered the controller only applies it if the command's station and epoch exactly match the current live lease and there is still fuel; a matching command records its (station, epoch) into the applied set, while any command that is stale, from the wrong station, or arrives after expiry is dropped without any effect. This guarantees the belt only ever moves under a genuine, current authorization.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every (station, epoch) pair recorded as having advanced the belt is a pair that was actually granted a lease, so no stale or unauthorized command ever takes effect.

---- MODULE W4Od12m1p4t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Banks, Cap
NoTok == "stalled"
VARIABLES token, alive, stock, served
vars == <<token, alive, stock, served>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ token \in Banks \cup {NoTok}
  /\ alive \in [Banks -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ stock \in [Banks -> 0..Cap]
  /\ served \in 0..(3 * Cap)

Init ==
  /\ token \in Banks
  /\ alive = [b \in Banks |-> TRUE]
  /\ stock = [b \in Banks |-> 0]
  /\ served = 0

PassToken(b) ==
  /\ token \in Banks
  /\ alive[token]
  /\ alive[b]
  /\ b # token
  /\ token' = b
  /\ UNCHANGED <<alive, stock, served>>

Crash(b) ==
  /\ alive[b]
  /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![b] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, stock, served>>

Reassign(b) ==
  /\ (token = NoTok \/ ~alive[token])
  /\ alive[b]
  /\ token' = b
  /\ UNCHANGED <<alive, stock, served>>

Admit ==
  /\ token \in Banks
  /\ alive[token]
  /\ stock[token] < Cap
  /\ stock' = [stock EXCEPT ![token] = @ + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, alive, served>>

Withdraw(b) ==
  /\ stock[b] > 0
  /\ served < 3 * Cap
  /\ stock' = [stock EXCEPT ![b] = @ - 1]
  /\ served' = served + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<token, alive>>

Next ==
  \/ \E b \in Banks : PassToken(b)
  \/ \E b \in Banks : Crash(b)
  \/ \E b \in Banks : Reassign(b)
  \/ Admit
  \/ \E b \in Banks : Withdraw(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

WithinCapacity == \A b \in Banks : stock[b] <= Cap
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Banks = {b1, b2, b3}
  Cap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT WithinCapacity
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A regional blood-bank network arranges its cold-storage banks in a ring and circulates a single access token; only the bank currently holding the token may accept an incoming shipment into its own storage buffer. Each bank's buffer has a fixed capacity and the token holder admits one unit at a time, refusing any admission that would overflow its buffer. Banks may also dispense units to hospitals, freeing buffer space. A bank can crash silently at any moment, becoming unresponsive without notifying anyone; if the crashed bank was holding the token the network detects the stall and reassigns the token to some bank that is still alive. Token passing otherwise moves the token to another live bank around the ring. Because admissions are gated on the holder's remaining space and crashes only remove a bank from service, no buffer is ever driven past its capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every bank's stored quantity always stays within that bank's fixed capacity, so bounded capacity is never exceeded.

---- MODULE W4Od6m8p1t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers
CONSTANTS Ctrls, MaxVal
Nobody == "nobody"
VARIABLES coarse, fine, value, active, snap
vars == <<coarse, fine, value, active, snap>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ coarse \in Ctrls \cup {Nobody}
  /\ fine \in Ctrls \cup {Nobody}
  /\ value \in 0..MaxVal
  /\ active \in Ctrls \cup {Nobody}
  /\ snap \in -1..MaxVal

Init ==
  /\ coarse = Nobody
  /\ fine = Nobody
  /\ value = 0
  /\ active = Nobody
  /\ snap = -1

TakeCoarse(c) ==
  /\ coarse = Nobody
  /\ coarse' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, value, active, snap>>

TakeFine(c) ==
  /\ coarse = c
  /\ fine = Nobody
  /\ fine' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, value, active, snap>>

ReadSnap(c) ==
  /\ fine = c
  /\ active = Nobody
  /\ active' = c
  /\ snap' = value
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, value>>

Commit(c) ==
  /\ active = c
  /\ snap < MaxVal
  /\ value' = snap + 1
  /\ active' = Nobody
  /\ snap' = -1
  /\ coarse' = Nobody
  /\ fine' = Nobody

AdminOverride ==
  /\ active = Nobody
  /\ value < MaxVal
  /\ value' = value + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, active, snap>>

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Ctrls : TakeCoarse(c)
  \/ \E c \in Ctrls : TakeFine(c)
  \/ \E c \in Ctrls : ReadSnap(c)
  \/ \E c \in Ctrls : Commit(c)
  \/ AdminOverride

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate == (active = Nobody) \/ (snap = value)
====

CONSTANTS
  Ctrls = {c1, c2}
  MaxVal = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper keeps a single shared dispatch record that must be updated without losing concurrent changes. To modify the record an elevator controller must first take a coarse-grained building lock and then a fine-grained shaft lock, in that order. Once it holds both locks the controller reads a private snapshot of the record's current value, then later commits by writing back its snapshot incremented by its own contribution and releasing both locks. Because acquisition of both locks is required before a snapshot is taken and held, no other controller can slip a write in between one controller's read and its commit. A privileged building-management admin may also adjust the record directly, but the override is only permitted when no controller is currently mid-update, so it too cannot clobber an in-flight change. This discipline ensures that whenever a controller is holding a snapshot, the live record still equals what it read.
SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a controller is in the middle of an update holding a read snapshot, the shared record still equals that snapshot, so no update is silently lost.

---- MODULE W4Od1m1p0t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Planes, MaxGen
Msgs == [to : Planes, gen : 0..MaxGen]
VARIABLES holder, onRun, net, gen
vars == <<holder, onRun, net, gen>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ holder \in Planes
  /\ onRun \in [Planes -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ net \subseteq Msgs
  /\ gen \in 0..MaxGen

Init ==
  /\ holder \in Planes
  /\ onRun = [p \in Planes |-> FALSE]
  /\ net = {}
  /\ gen = 0

Enter(p) ==
  /\ holder = p
  /\ ~onRun[p]
  /\ onRun' = [onRun EXCEPT ![p] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, net, gen>>

Leave(p) ==
  /\ onRun[p]
  /\ onRun' = [onRun EXCEPT ![p] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, net, gen>>

SendPass(q) ==
  /\ ~onRun[holder]
  /\ gen < MaxGen
  /\ net' = net \cup {[to |-> q, gen |-> gen]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, onRun, gen>>

Deliver(m) ==
  /\ m.gen = gen
  /\ ~onRun[holder]
  /\ holder' = m.to
  /\ gen' = gen + 1
  /\ net' = net \ {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<onRun>>

DropStale(m) ==
  /\ m.gen # gen
  /\ net' = net \ {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, onRun, gen>>

Next ==
  \/ \E p \in Planes : Enter(p)
  \/ \E p \in Planes : Leave(p)
  \/ \E q \in Planes : SendPass(q)
  \/ \E m \in net : Deliver(m)
  \/ \E m \in net : DropStale(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MutualExclusion == \A p \in Planes : onRun[p] => (holder = p)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Planes = {a1, a2, a3}
  MaxGen = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutualExclusion
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator lets several aircraft share one physical runway by circulating a single access token. Only the aircraft currently holding the token may taxi onto the runway; it enters, occupies the runway, and later vacates it. To hand the token to another aircraft, the current holder (which must itself be idle, not on the runway) emits a hand-off message stamped with the current token generation number onto the control network. The network can delay and reorder these messages, so several hand-off messages may be in flight at once, possibly stamped with generations that are now out of date. When a hand-off message is delivered it is honored only if its generation matches the live token generation, in which case the token moves to the named aircraft and the generation advances; a message carrying a stale generation is discarded with no effect. Because only the token holder may enter, and the token is a single unique grant, the runway is never occupied by two aircraft at once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: at any instant at most one aircraft occupies the runway, because any aircraft on the runway must be the unique current token holder.

---- MODULE W4Od7m9p1t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers
CONSTANTS Ops, MaxEpoch, MaxVal
Idle == "idle"
VARIABLES epoch, value, writer, snapE, snapV, alive
vars == <<epoch, value, writer, snapE, snapV, alive>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ value \in 0..MaxVal
  /\ writer \in Ops \cup {Idle}
  /\ snapE \in -1..MaxEpoch
  /\ snapV \in -1..MaxVal
  /\ alive \in [Ops -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ value = 0
  /\ writer = Idle
  /\ snapE = -1
  /\ snapV = -1
  /\ alive = [o \in Ops |-> TRUE]

Reconfigure ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<value, writer, snapE, snapV, alive>>

Begin(o) ==
  /\ alive[o]
  /\ writer = Idle
  /\ writer' = o
  /\ snapE' = epoch
  /\ snapV' = value
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, value, alive>>

Commit(o) ==
  /\ writer = o
  /\ snapE = epoch
  /\ snapV < MaxVal
  /\ value' = snapV + 1
  /\ writer' = Idle
  /\ snapE' = -1
  /\ snapV' = -1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, alive>>

Abort(o) ==
  /\ writer = o
  /\ snapE # epoch
  /\ writer' = Idle
  /\ snapE' = -1
  /\ snapV' = -1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, value, alive>>

Crash(o) ==
  /\ alive[o]
  /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![o] = FALSE]
  /\ writer' = IF writer = o THEN Idle ELSE writer
  /\ snapE' = IF writer = o THEN -1 ELSE snapE
  /\ snapV' = IF writer = o THEN -1 ELSE snapV
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, value>>

Next ==
  \/ Reconfigure
  \/ \E o \in Ops : Begin(o)
  \/ \E o \in Ops : Commit(o)
  \/ \E o \in Ops : Abort(o)
  \/ \E o \in Ops : Crash(o)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate == (writer = Idle) \/ (snapE # epoch) \/ (snapV = value)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Ops = {o1, o2}
  MaxEpoch = 2
  MaxVal = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A container-ship crane yard maintains one shared stowage manifest that crane operators update, and it periodically reconfigures its coordination epoch when the yard layout changes. Each reconfiguration bumps a strictly increasing epoch number. To change the manifest an operator begins a write by recording both the current epoch and the current manifest value as a private snapshot. Later it attempts to commit: the commit succeeds only if the epoch is still the one it snapshotted, writing the manifest to its snapshot value plus its increment; if the epoch has since advanced the operator aborts and discards its work. Only one operator writes at a time. An operator can crash silently, and if it was mid-write the yard simply releases its write slot. Because a commit is refused whenever the epoch has moved since the snapshot, and the manifest changes only through such guarded commits, an in-flight writer whose epoch is still current always sees the manifest exactly as it read it.
SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever an operator is mid-write and its snapshot epoch still equals the live epoch, the manifest value equals the value it snapshotted, so no update is lost.

---- MODULE W4Od12m5p1t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Banks, Quorum, MaxVal
NoProp == "none"
VARIABLES reserve, proposer, baseline, ballots
vars == <<reserve, proposer, baseline, ballots>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ reserve \in 0..MaxVal
  /\ proposer \in Banks \cup {NoProp}
  /\ baseline \in -1..MaxVal
  /\ ballots \subseteq Banks

Init ==
  /\ reserve = 0
  /\ proposer = NoProp
  /\ baseline = -1
  /\ ballots = {}

Open(b) ==
  /\ proposer = NoProp
  /\ proposer' = b
  /\ baseline' = reserve
  /\ ballots' = {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED reserve

CastVote(b) ==
  /\ proposer # NoProp
  /\ b \notin ballots
  /\ ballots' = ballots \cup {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<reserve, proposer, baseline>>

Commit ==
  /\ proposer # NoProp
  /\ Cardinality(ballots) >= Quorum
  /\ baseline = reserve
  /\ reserve < MaxVal
  /\ reserve' = baseline + 1
  /\ proposer' = NoProp
  /\ baseline' = -1
  /\ ballots' = {}

Abort ==
  /\ proposer # NoProp
  /\ baseline # reserve
  /\ proposer' = NoProp
  /\ baseline' = -1
  /\ ballots' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED reserve

AdminOverride ==
  /\ proposer = NoProp
  /\ reserve < MaxVal
  /\ reserve' = reserve + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<proposer, baseline, ballots>>

Next ==
  \/ \E b \in Banks : Open(b)
  \/ \E b \in Banks : CastVote(b)
  \/ Commit
  \/ Abort
  \/ AdminOverride

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate == (proposer = NoProp) \/ (baseline = reserve)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Banks = {b1, b2, b3}
  Quorum = 2
  MaxVal = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker guards its shared reserve count so that concurrent adjustments never clobber one another, and it requires a quorum of participating banks to approve each change. A bank opens a proposal by snapshotting the current reserve count as its baseline and recording its own approving vote. Other banks may add their votes to the open proposal. The proposal commits only when it has collected at least a quorum of votes and its baseline still equals the live reserve, at which point the reserve is written to the baseline plus one and the proposal closes. If the reserve has drifted away from the baseline before the quorum commits, the proposal is aborted so it cannot overwrite the newer value. A privileged regional admin may adjust the reserve directly, but only when no proposal is open, so the override cannot erase an in-flight change either. Consequently, while a proposal is open its baseline always matches the live reserve.
SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a proposal is open, the recorded baseline still equals the live reserve count, so no committed adjustment is ever silently lost.

---- MODULE W4Od14m3p5t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Drones, Cells, MaxTerm
NoLeader == "none"
Orders == [cell : Cells, term : 1..MaxTerm, by : Drones]
VARIABLES term, leader, radio, treated
vars == <<term, leader, radio, treated>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
  /\ leader \in Drones \cup {NoLeader}
  /\ radio \subseteq Orders
  /\ treated \subseteq Orders

Init ==
  /\ term = 0
  /\ leader = NoLeader
  /\ radio = {}
  /\ treated = {}

Elect(d) ==
  /\ term < MaxTerm
  /\ term' = term + 1
  /\ leader' = d
  /\ UNCHANGED <<radio, treated>>

LeaderFail ==
  /\ leader # NoLeader
  /\ leader' = NoLeader
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, radio, treated>>

Command(c) ==
  /\ leader # NoLeader
  /\ term >= 1
  /\ radio' = radio \cup {[cell |-> c, term |-> term, by |-> leader]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, treated>>

Execute(m) ==
  /\ m.term = term
  /\ \A e \in treated : e.cell # m.cell
  /\ treated' = treated \cup {m}
  /\ radio' = radio \ {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader>>

Discard(m) ==
  /\ (m.term # term \/ \E e \in treated : e.cell = m.cell)
  /\ radio' = radio \ {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, treated>>

Next ==
  \/ \E d \in Drones : Elect(d)
  \/ LeaderFail
  \/ \E c \in Cells : Command(c)
  \/ \E m \in radio : Execute(m)
  \/ \E m \in radio : Discard(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TreatedAtMostOnce ==
  \A e1 \in treated, e2 \in treated : (e1.cell = e2.cell) => (e1 = e2)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Drones = {d1, d2}
  Cells = {g1, g2}
  MaxTerm = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT TreatedAtMostOnce
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm elects a single leader that alone may command the irreversible release of fire retardant onto a burning ground cell. Leadership uses monotonically increasing terms: an election installs a new leader and advances the term, and the current leader may also fail, leaving the swarm temporarily leaderless until the next election provides failover. The leader issues retardant-release orders, each stamped with the term under which it was issued, onto the swarm radio; the radio may delay and reorder orders, so an order minted under an old term can arrive after a newer election. A delivered order is executed only if its term matches the live term and its target cell has not already been treated, whereupon the cell is recorded as treated under that term and leader. Orders carrying a stale term, or targeting an already-treated cell, are discarded with no effect. Because a cell can be recorded as treated only when it has no prior treatment, no ground cell is ever hit with retardant more than once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no ground cell is ever recorded as treated with retardant more than once, so the irreversible release happens at most once per cell.

---- MODULE W4Od14m6p5t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Drones, Zones, MaxEpoch, Dur
Vacant == "vacant"
Reqs == [zone : Zones, ep : 1..MaxEpoch, by : Drones]
VARIABLES owner, fuel, epoch, queue, blown
vars == <<owner, fuel, epoch, queue, blown>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ owner \in Drones \cup {Vacant}
  /\ fuel \in 0..Dur
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ queue \subseteq Reqs
  /\ blown \subseteq Reqs

Init ==
  /\ owner = Vacant
  /\ fuel = 0
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ queue = {}
  /\ blown = {}

Grant(d) ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ owner' = d
  /\ fuel' = Dur
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, blown>>

Age ==
  /\ fuel > 0
  /\ fuel' = fuel - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, epoch, queue, blown>>

Submit(z) ==
  /\ owner # Vacant
  /\ fuel > 0
  /\ epoch >= 1
  /\ queue' = queue \cup {[zone |-> z, ep |-> epoch, by |-> owner]}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, fuel, epoch, blown>>

Detonate(m) ==
  /\ m.ep = epoch
  /\ m.by = owner
  /\ fuel > 0
  /\ \A e \in blown : e.zone # m.zone
  /\ blown' = blown \cup {m}
  /\ queue' = queue \ {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, fuel, epoch>>

Reject(m) ==
  /\ (m.ep # epoch \/ m.by # owner \/ fuel = 0 \/ \E e \in blown : e.zone = m.zone)
  /\ queue' = queue \ {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, fuel, epoch, blown>>

Next ==
  \/ \E d \in Drones : Grant(d)
  \/ Age
  \/ \E z \in Zones : Submit(z)
  \/ \E m \in queue : Detonate(m)
  \/ \E m \in queue : Reject(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

DetonateOncePerZone ==
  \A e1 \in blown, e2 \in blown : (e1.zone = e2.zone) => (e1 = e2)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Drones = {d1, d2}
  Zones = {z1, z2}
  MaxEpoch = 2
  Dur = 1
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT DetonateOncePerZone
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm authorizes the irreversible detonation of firebreak charges in ground zones using a short-lived lease held by one drone. A dispatcher grants the lease to a drone with a fuel budget that counts down as time passes and a fresh strictly increasing epoch; when the fuel hits zero the lease has expired. While it believes it holds a live lease, a drone may be slow: it submits a detonation request tagged with the epoch it saw, and that request can sit queued and arrive much later. When a queued request is finally processed it triggers a detonation only if its epoch still matches the live lease epoch, there is still fuel, and the target zone has not already been detonated; the zone is then recorded as detonated together with the epoch and drone. A request whose epoch is stale, whose lease has since expired, or whose zone is already done is rejected outright. Because detonation is gated on both a still-valid lease and the zone being untouched, no zone is ever detonated more than once even when a slow drone acts on outdated authority.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no ground zone is ever recorded as detonated more than once, so the irreversible detonation happens at most once per zone.

---- MODULE W4Od12m5p5t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Insts, Units, Voters, Quorum
NoUnit == "idle"
VARIABLES proposal, ballots, discarded, log
vars == <<proposal, ballots, discarded, log>>

Events == [unit : Units, by : Insts]

TypeOK ==
  /\ proposal \in [Insts -> Units \cup {NoUnit}]
  /\ ballots \in [Insts -> SUBSET Voters]
  /\ discarded \subseteq Units
  /\ log \subseteq Events

Init ==
  /\ proposal = [i \in Insts |-> NoUnit]
  /\ ballots = [i \in Insts |-> {}]
  /\ discarded = {}
  /\ log = {}

Propose(i, u) ==
  /\ proposal[i] = NoUnit
  /\ u \notin discarded
  /\ proposal' = [proposal EXCEPT ![i] = u]
  /\ ballots' = [ballots EXCEPT ![i] = {}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<discarded, log>>

Vote(i, v) ==
  /\ proposal[i] # NoUnit
  /\ v \notin ballots[i]
  /\ ballots' = [ballots EXCEPT ![i] = @ \cup {v}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<proposal, discarded, log>>

Commit(i) ==
  /\ proposal[i] # NoUnit
  /\ Cardinality(ballots[i]) >= Quorum
  /\ proposal[i] \notin discarded
  /\ discarded' = discarded \cup {proposal[i]}
  /\ log' = log \cup {[unit |-> proposal[i], by |-> i]}
  /\ proposal' = [proposal EXCEPT ![i] = NoUnit]
  /\ ballots' = [ballots EXCEPT ![i] = {}]

Abort(i) ==
  /\ proposal[i] # NoUnit
  /\ proposal[i] \in discarded
  /\ proposal' = [proposal EXCEPT ![i] = NoUnit]
  /\ ballots' = [ballots EXCEPT ![i] = {}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<discarded, log>>

Next ==
  \/ \E i \in Insts, u \in Units : Propose(i, u)
  \/ \E i \in Insts, v \in Voters : Vote(i, v)

A vending machine network runs two independent backend instances that share one pool of product-column slots, and it renumbers its coordination epoch whenever the planogram is reconfigured. Either instance issues a claim on a column slot by placing a request, tagged with the current epoch, into the shared request pool; requests may be delayed and reordered. A queued claim is granted only if its epoch still matches the live epoch and the target column is currently unowned, in which case the column is marked owned by the claiming instance and an active reservation pairing the column and instance is recorded. A claim whose epoch is stale or whose column is already owned is rejected. An instance may release a column it owns, clearing the ownership marker and dropping the reservation. Because a grant requires the column to be unowned at grant time and both instances consult the same ownership markers, no column is ever reserved by two different instances at once.

A car-wash conveyor line runs two independent controller instances that draw cars from one shared pool, and applying the hot-wax coat to a car is irreversible once committed. Each instance drives a two-phase commit transaction: a transaction begins by targeting a car that has not yet been waxed and enters its voting phase. If the target car has meanwhile been waxed by the other instance's transaction, this transaction aborts instead. Because a commit requires the car to still be unwaxed and atomically marks it, no car is ever hot-waxed more than once even though both instances share the same pool of cars.

A university course-registration system serializes changes to a section's shared enrollment record using two nested locks: a coarse department lock taken first, then a fine section lock. A registrar becomes the active writer only while it simultaneously holds both locks; it may then commit one enrollment, which increments the seat count, and on committing it releases both locks and gives up its active-writer status. SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever some registrar is the active writer of the enrollment record, that registrar currently holds both the coarse and the fine lock, so no unauthorized or stale registrar ever writes.

A subway signalling block system admits trains into a track region that can safely hold only a fixed number of trains at once. To enter, a train must first take the coarse region interlock and then the fine block interlock, in that order. A permit whose generation is out of date is discarded. A train already inside may leave, decreasing occupancy. Because entry is gated on occupancy being strictly below capacity, the number of trains in the region never exceeds its capacity.

A warehouse robot fleet gates every pallet-move action behind supervisor quorum approval so that no move is executed without sufficient authority. A robot opens a proposal for a move, after which supervisors cast approving votes that accumulate as a set. The fleet coordinator occasionally reconfigures, advancing an epoch; a reconfiguration invalidates the votes gathered under the old configuration, clearing the current proposal's accumulated approvals so that stale approvals cannot be reused.   /\ reading' = [reading EXCEPT ![i] = [active |-> TRUE, slot |-> s, seen |-> version[s]]]

  /\ version[reading[i].slot] = reading[i].seen
  /\ assigned[reading[i].slot] = Free
  /\ version[reading[i].slot] < MaxVer
  /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![reading[i].slot] = i]
  /\ version' = [version EXCEPT ![reading[i].slot] = @ + 1]
  /\ log' = log \cup {[slot |-> reading[i].slot, inst |-> i]}
  /\ reading' = [reading EXCEPT ![i] = [active |-> FALSE, slot |-> reading[i].slot, seen |-> 0]]

  /\ version[reading[i].slot] # reading[i].seen
  /\ reading' = [reading EXCEPT ![i] = [active |-> FALSE, slot |-> reading[i].slot, seen |-> 0]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<version, assigned, log>>

CONSTANTS
  Insts = {i1, i2}
  Slots = {r1, r2}
  MaxVer = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT AssignOncePerSlot
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator lets two independent controller instances share one set of landing-commit slots, assigning a landing to a slot with optimistic locking and retry. Each slot carries a version counter and an assignment marker. To assign, an instance first reads a slot, privately remembering the slot and the version it observed. It then attempts to commit: the commit succeeds only if the slot's version still equals the version it read and the slot is still unassigned, in which case the slot is marked assigned to that instance, the version is bumped, and an assignment record naming the slot and instance is logged. If the version has moved since the read, the optimistic attempt fails and the instance simply drops its read to retry later. A background process may also bump the version of an unassigned slot, modelling concurrent contention that forces optimistic retries. Because a commit installs an assignment only when the slot is observed unchanged and still unassigned, and assignment is irreversible, no landing slot is ever assigned twice.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the assignment log never records two assignments for the same landing slot, so the irreversible assignment of any slot happens at most once even across the two shared instances.
